ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% high-intensity white/cream pixels across the central surface area against 10-15% low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black banding restricted to the entire trailing edge boundary. One distinct, high-contrast dark circular blob located in the mid-section of the right lobe. Minor dark pixel cluster at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation; approximately 45-degree internal angle with a high vertical-to-horizontal bounding box depth ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate amplitude variations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep valleys between the notch and distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves extending from the median notch, terminating in sharp, slightly swept-back distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small, low-contrast circular indentations scattered across the white field of both lobes. One high-contrast, dark circular spot (approx. 50-pixel diameter) on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical tan/brownish linear staining visible on both lobes, but no high-contrast unaligned structural rake marks are detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular lesion or pigmentation spot on the right lobe; irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread brownish biological staining or discoloration concentrated near the center-line and lower regions of both fluke lobes.
